title: Coding agents ne AI ko 1.7x fast kiya
content:
AI agents ne ek AI model ko 1.7 times FAST bana diya.
Not by changing the model. By rewriting the code that runs it.
Ye vLLM ke official blog pe aaya hai.
vLLM ek open-source engine hai jo AI models ko serve karta hai.
NVIDIA ke engineer ne likha ki unhone Kimi K3 model ke liye naye GPU kernels banaye.
And they used agent-assisted development to build them.
Matlab coding agents ne sabse mushkil kaam mein help ki.
Kernel kya hota hai?
Simple bhasha mein... GPU pe chalne wale chhote programs.
Model ka har word in kernels se hokar nikalta hai.
If these programs are slow, the whole model feels slow.
Ab numbers dekho. Yahin asli kahani hai.
Sixteen GB300 GPUs pe, ek user ke liye, naya path 842 tokens per second deta hai.
Stock vLLM same setup pe 488 deta tha.
That is a 1.73x speedup on the same benchmark.
Har layer ka time 130 microseconds se 69 pe aa gaya.
Aur kernels 23 se ghat ke 13 reh gaye.
Kam kaam, kam wait, zyada speed.
Fewer kernels means less time switching between small jobs on the GPU.
Aur jab model fast hota hai, agent ka har step bhi fast hota hai.
Par dhyan do. Ye bahut specific setup hai.
It is NVIDIA Blackwell hardware with a controlled benchmark.
Aapke laptop pe ye number nahi aayega.
Aur ye feature abhi opt-in hai, default nahi.
Mera take simple hai... asli lesson speed nahi hai.
Lesson ye hai ki coding agents ab sirf website nahi banate.
They are helping experts with GPU code, testing and tuning.
Lekin dekho, blog ka title bhi bolta hai... moving fast AND responsibly.
Agent likhta hai, insaan check karta hai, benchmark prove karta hai.
Maan lo aap apne project mein agent use karte ho... same rule follow karo.
Har change ko measure karo, sirf trust mat karo.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
